newsitem.title: USA: Boeing has broad product line after merger..
newsitem.headline: Boeing has broad product line after merger..

text.p: Following are some of the principal programs of Boeing Co. after its merger with McDonnell Douglas Corp.
From McDonnell Douglas: MD-11, MD-80/90, MD-95.
From Boeing: F-22 wings and components, Joint Strike Fighter (prototypes), airborne laser, 767 AWACS.
From McDonnell Douglas: AV-8B Harrier II, F-15 Eagle, F/A-18 Hornet, F/A-18 Super Hornet, C-17 Globemaster III.
From Boeing: CH-47D Chinook, RAH-66 Comanche, V-22 Osprey, Bell-Boeing civil tiltrotor.
From McDonnell Douglas: AH-64D Apache, MD-500/600, MD Explorer.
From Boeing: Space station, Sea Launch, Avenger air defense system , HELLFIRE missile family.
From McDonnell Douglas: Delta II/III rockets, Evolved Expendable Launch Vehicle, Harpoon and Tomahawk missiles.
